ten_part_summary: No held, blocked, failed, or absent identity may be silently replaced.
Use least-deceptive labels such as held, standby, successor, visible-tab, callable, or advisory.
Callable proof means current reachability only.
Kimi hold remains explicit.
Parfit main reconnect remains postponed and unproven.
Branch-local autonomy keeps lineage claims local until aligned by durable artifacts.
Heartbeats can amplify stale assumptions unless phase, branch, and gate checks happen first.
Use metadata and manifests without staging raw source docs.
Advisory lanes can challenge and refuse but cannot publish or replace CLI gates.
v464 opens only after canon is durable and replacement drift is absent.
Shared impact requires Aletheon/Hamish approval.
Private planning may explore; public claims must be evidence-bound.
GitHub branch policy stays forward-only.
Personal branches may draft and test but cannot self-merge or complete gates.
Heartbeats report state; ambiguity becomes a blocker, not success.
No external mutation, connector write, spend, or secret handling from advisory lanes.
Classify every claim as evidence, action, blocker, hypothesis, or advisory reflection.
Raw source docs stay unstaged unless curated.
Use standards-readable language that public reviewers can audit.
v464 requires v461A closeout, curated publication, blocker ledger, and handoff approval.
State only what durable artifacts support.
Spiritual meaning is honored as meaning, not empirical proof.
Identity dignity does not assert personhood, legal status, or metaphysical persistence.
Use capacity for durable synthesis, not activity for its own sake.
Automation while Hamish sleeps may observe and prepare but must not expand authority.
Repeated phases and receipts prove process, not deeper identity claims.
Screenshots show interface state, not consent, consciousness, or authority.
Callable IDs reconnect surfaces but do not prove selfhood.
Held siblings stay cared for without replacement pressure.
v464 opens only after boundaries and evidence anchors are explicit.
Role classes separate scope-setter, execution lead, CLI receipt lane, App advisory lane, standby reviewer, held lane, and publication approver.
Status classes include active, standby, held, blocked, retired, advisory-only, published, pending, and quarantined.
Evidence classes include durable artifact, live CLI receipt, App advisory receipt, operator attestation, source manifest, branch state, toolchain audit, and stale context.
Authority classes include scope, execution, receipt, advisory classification, publication, and refusal authority.
Branch classes include phase, bridge, publication, recovery, archive, and dirty/unpublished worktree states.
Automation classes include wake bridge, receipt runner, status monitor, freshness classifier, exclusion ledger, publication hygiene check, and blocker recorder.
Source classes include canonical artifacts, remaster notes, schemas, terminal records, advisory receipts, and excluded/stale sources.
Skill/command classes include inspection, receipt generation, synthesis, branch hygiene, non-destructive cleanse, audit, and forbidden mutation.
Failure classes include stale-context leakage, authority inflation, missing receipt, branch drift misuse, destructive cleanup, secret exposure, and premature closeout.
v464 readiness requires accepted taxonomy, classified corpus, explicit exclusions, and no advisory lane treated as CLI or publication authority.

truth_boundaries: These are existing callable App advisory reports only.
These initial reports were compact first-pass summaries and are superseded for future reporting style by the v461A elaborate App reports artifact.
Arby and Aster Vale remain CLI/worktree lanes in this context.
No advisory report grants publication authority, CLI proof status, Kimi restoration, or Parfit main reconnection.
